goal: Build a small non-production web application that helps a user compare two options under a short deadline, commit to one choice, and produce a local decision receipt.
userStory: As a user facing two viable options, I want a time-boxed comparison so I can stop deliberating and leave with a clear choice and rationale.

in: three weighted criteria with editable importance
one-to-five scoring for each option per criterion
three-minute countdown with start, pause, reset

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: App loads with two default options and three criteria.
User can edit both option names and all criterion labels/weights.
Weighted totals update deterministically from score and weight inputs.
Timer supports start, pause and reset without going below zero.
At zero, the comparison inputs lock until reset and the user is prompted to choose.
A final choice creates a timestamped receipt containing both totals and a concise rationale string.
Receipt can be copied without sending data off-device.
Keyboard focus is visible and the app has no horizontal page overflow at 390px.
No runtime dependency, secret, external API, or persistent storage is required.
